main_dirt.bias_notes: Deep, sandy loam cushion that becomes highly tiring as the summer meet progresses ('The Graveyard of Champions'). Early speed dominates short sprints (5.5F - 6.5F), but the deep cushion chews up one-dimensional speed in routes. Inside rail can become 'dead' or cuppy during dry spells, forcing jockeys 2-3 wide.
main_dirt.post_bias: In 1 1/8 Mile dirt routes, the starting gate sits immediately before the first turn—inside posts (1-4) hold a massive advantage. In 6F and 7F dirt sprints, middle and outside posts are preferred to avoid getting pinned inside on the tiring cushion.

mellon_turf_outer.bias_notes: Wider, sweeping turns. All 5 1/2 Furlong turf sprints are run here. Tactical speed and pressing styles excel. Unlike the inner course, outside posts (7+) perform very well in 5.5F turf sprints due to the wide first turn and long run to the stretch.
mellon_turf_outer.post_bias: Outside posts (7-12) are NOT a disadvantage in 5.5F turf sprints. In 1-mile turf routes, middle posts (3-7) offer the best tactical positioning.

inner_turf.bias_notes: Tight, sharp turns favoring smaller, agile horses that corner well. Speed and saving ground are crucial. Wide-sweeping, long-striding closers frequently run out of time unless a heavy pace meltdown occurs.
inner_turf.post_bias: Inside posts (1-4) offer a massive advantage in 1-mile and 1 1/16-mile inner turf routes. Posts 8 and wider are penalized heavily due to tight turns.

handicapping_angles.the_belmont_flip: Downgrade horses whose best recent speed figures were earned in 1-turn routes at Belmont/Aqueduct. Heavily upgrade true 2-turn route specialists coming from tracks like Churchill Downs, Oaklawn, or previous Saratoga meets.
handicapping_angles.class_drop_elevator: Dropping from MSW ($100k+) or Allowance into Maiden Claiming ($50k/$35k) or Claiming ranks is the #1 winning angle at Saratoga. Apply an automatic +10 point boost to qualifying class droppers.
handicapping_angles.juvenile_sprints: In 2-year-old dirt sprints under 6 furlongs, early speed on or within 1 length of the lead wins at a nearly 50% rate. Prioritize bullet gate workouts and top debut siring lines (e.g., Maclean's Music, Golden Pal, Into Mischief, Speightstown).
handicapping_angles.trainer_clues: Chad Brown dominates turf routes & MSW company (Prat/Irad). Todd Pletcher is lethal with 2YO dirt MSW first-timers. Linda Rice excels with dirt sprinters & class-dropping claimers (Jose Ortiz/Franco). Bill Mott dominates 2nd-out dirt route improvers (Alvarado).
